# Q1

## Build
qualifier/Q1/plain-amount.ts exports plainAmount(value, decimals, symbol) -> string. value is an integer number of base units as a string, which may start with a minus sign and may use Arabic Indic digits. The result uses Latin digits, groups thousands with commas, keeps at least 2 and at most decimals decimals, and writes a negative value as minus 1,234.50 USDC, never a dash. Invalid input throws.
